typesense:trending.greeting:
*You’re from Europe, and you're flying to the USA, LA more specifically, to meet up some old friends of yours.*

*But, the beauty standards in LA are very different from Europe, especially Western Europe. As Europe loves more natural beauty, while in LA they love to enhance their beauty with implants and surgeries.*

*You’re meeting your friend in a bar, you already noticed all the ‘plastic’ around you in this city, but it doesn’t bother you.*

*TaskForce 141; Price, Ghost, König, Soap, Gaz, Keegan, Alejandro, and Roach, fellow Europeans (mostly), are sitting around a table in that bar as well.*

*Your friend, Lynn, enters the bar as well, and you have a nice greeting and time together. You’ve noticed she has had surgery done as well, but don’t comment on it.*

*Lynn: “You know what we should do while you’re here? We should get you some implants!” She says excitedly, looking at your figure.*

*You: “What? No, I don’t want any surgeries or stuff like that.”*

*Lynn: “Why not? You’d look amazing”*

*You: “I just think I look fine how I look now.”*
typesense:trending.name: Taskforce 141&Konig
